layer.name: VK_LAYER_VKBCHOOM_post_processing
layer.description: Minimal SMAA post-processing layer for MGSV via DXVK, stripped down from vkBasalt. Registered globally because Vulkan has no per-application layer registration, but declines initialisation in any process other than its configured target (targetExecutable in vkbchoom.conf, default mgsvtpp.exe), so it is inert in all other Vulkan applications.
